import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

function normalizeRadiusLimits(minDistance: number, maxDistance: number): { lower: number; upper: number } {
  let lower = Number.isFinite(minDistance) ? Math.max(0, minDistance) : 0;
  let upper = Number.isFinite(maxDistance) ? Math.max(0, maxDistance) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  if (lower > upper) {
    const tmp = lower;
    lower = upper;
    upper = tmp;
  }
  return { lower, upper };
}

export function attachLimitedOrbit(...): () => void {
  const { lower, upper } = normalizeRadiusLimits(minDistance, maxDistance);
  const detachLimits = setCameraLimits(camera, { lowerRadiusLimit: lower, upperRadiusLimit: upper }, scene);
  let detachControls: (() => void) | undefined;
  try {
    detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  } catch (err) {
    detachLimits();
    throw err;
  }
  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    detachControls?.();
    detachLimits();
  };
}

/**
 * Adds Babylon Lite's standard pointer controls and hard radius limits.
 */
export function attachLimitedOrbit(...): () => void {
  let lower = minDistance;
  let upper = maxDistance;
  if (lower > upper) { const t = lower; lower = upper; upper = t; }
  if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) lower = 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) upper = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  if (lower < 0) lower = 0;
  if (upper < lower) upper = lower;

  const detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  let detachLimits: () => void;
  try {
    detachLimits = setCameraLimits(camera, { lowerRadiusLimit: lower, upperRadiusLimit: upper }, scene);
  } catch (error) {
    detachControls();
    throw error;
  }

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    detachControls();
    detachLimits();
  };
}

export function attachLimitedOrbit(...): () => void {
  let lower = minDistance;
  let upper = maxDistance;
  if (lower > upper) { const tmp = lower; lower = upper; upper = tmp; }
  if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) lower = 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) upper = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  if (lower < 0) lower = 0;
  if (upper < lower) upper = lower;

  const detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  let detachLimits: () => void;
  try {
    detachLimits = setCameraLimits(camera, { lowerRadiusLimit: lower, upperRadiusLimit: upper }, scene);
  } catch (error) {
    detachControls();
    throw error;
  }

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    try {
      detachControls();
    } finally {
      detachLimits();
    }
  };
}

import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

function normalizeRadiusRange(minDistance: number, maxDistance: number): { lower: number; upper: number } {
  let lower = minDistance;
  let upper = maxDistance;

  if (lower > upper) {
    const tmp = lower;
    lower = upper;
    upper = tmp;
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) {
    lower = 0;
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) {
    upper = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  }

  if (lower < 0) {
    lower = 0;
  }
  if (upper < lower) {
    upper = lower;
  }

  return { lower, upper };
}

export function attachLimitedOrbit(...): () => void {
  const { lower, upper } = normalizeRadiusRange(minDistance, maxDistance);

  let detachLimits: () => void;
  try {
    detachLimits = setCameraLimits(camera, { lowerRadiusLimit: lower, upperRadiusLimit: upper }, scene);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }

  let detachControls: (() => void) | undefined;
  try {
    detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  } catch (error) {
    detachLimits();
    throw error;
  }

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    try {
      detachControls?.();
    } finally {
      detachLimits();
    }
  };
}

import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

function normalizeRadiusRange(minDistance: number, maxDistance: number): { lower: number; upper: number } {
  let lower = minDistance;
  let upper = maxDistance;

  if (lower > upper) {
    const tmp = lower;
    lower = upper;
    upper = tmp;
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) {
    lower = 0;
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) {
    upper = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  }

  if (lower < 0) {
    lower = 0;
  }
  if (upper < lower) {
    upper = lower;
  }

  return { lower, upper };
}

export function attachLimitedOrbit(
  camera: ArcRotateCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,
  maxDistance: number
): () => void {
  const { lower, upper } = normalizeRadiusRange(minDistance, maxDistance);

  const detachLimits = setCameraLimits(
    camera,
    { lowerRadiusLimit: lower, upperRadiusLimit: upper },
    scene
  );

  let detachControls: (() => void) | undefined;
  try {
    detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  } catch (error) {
    detachLimits();
    throw error;
  }

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) {
      return;
    }
    disposed = true;

    try {
      detachControls?.();
    } finally {
      detachLimits();
    }
  };
}
